_meta.notes: SIDE ONE OF AN ORIGINAL/AMENDMENT PAIR. This is Nathan Evershed's April-5 2018 interim report; its amendment is raw/globalassets/2018_disclosures__april__evershed-amendment-april.pdf (cache key c199070b), also in this chunk, and the two are kept as SEPARATE records - no figure from one was copied onto the other, and each side was transcribed from its own pages. WHAT ACTUALLY DIFFERS BETWEEN THE PAIR (all four differences are on the cover and Summary Page; the schedules are the same transactions): (1) Summary line 1 Column A $25,215.00 -> $25,602.15; (2) Summary line 2 Column A $6,838.22 -> $7,164.47 - i.e. the amendment's whole purpose is to replace the two stale Column-A figures with the ones the schedules already carried, which is why the ORIGINAL's lines 1/2 disagree with its own lines 4/6 and the AMENDMENT's do not; (3) Column B (Aggregate Total) is BLANK on both money lines here and is FILLED on the amendment ($46,352.15 / $7,438.22) - a genuinely new fact, not a correction; (4) cover: amendment box unchecked here vs 'Yes, date of report 4/12/18' there, signature 4/5/18 vs 4/12/18, clerk stamp APR 05 2018 vs APR 16 2018. Lines 3, 5 and 7 are IDENTICAL across the pair, and both documents' Schedule A/B attachments carry the same 114 and 83 rows and the same grand totals (verified by transcribing each document separately, not by copying: the two PDFs are separate scans, not the same image - a pixel diff shows 3-12% of pixels differing from skew and offset alone). OTHER FINDINGS. index.csv dates this filing 2018-04-06; the FORM is signed 4/5/18 and the clerk's RECEIVED IN OFFICE stamp reads APR 05 2018, so the index date is one day later than anything printed on the document - the form governs. The Summary Page and both schedule stubs print 'Date of Report 3/31/18' (the period end), a third distinct date. The cover's 'Is this report an amendment?' has NEITHER Yes nor No checked - is_amendment is honestly blank, not 'No'. Column B is blank on both money lines: the field exists and the filer left it empty, so total_*_to_date are '' and not null. The typed cover matches index.csv on candidate and office (Nathan Evershed / SLCO District Attorney; District Number blank). STRUCTURE: this is the attachment-behind-stub shape - p3 and p7 are the county's own Schedule A/B grids carrying only 'See Attached' and a grand total, and the money lines live on the filer's own landscape spreadsheet (pp.4-6 contributions, pp.8-9 expenditures). The attachment pages are stored ROTATED inside the PDF and the sign is NOT uniform within this one document: pp.4-6 need a 90-degree CLOCKWISE rotation and pp.8-9 need a 90-degree COUNTER-CLOCKWISE one. PRIVACY: the attachment has separate Address / City / State / Zip Code columns and the county's black bar spans all four on every contribution row, so every donor_city/donor_state is blank as REDACTED AT SOURCE. Occupation/Employer sits to the right of the bar and survives on every page; it is captured verbatim where the filer wrote one and left '' with a note where he did not. On p6 the bar under-covers slightly at the top of row 1 - a sliver of the covered block is visible; nothing was read from it (PRIVACY.md: nothing is extracted from an imperfectly-redacted block).

contributions.detail: 114 transcribed rows sum to 25,602.15 EXACTLY = the filer attachment's own printed grand total (p6 'Total') = the county Schedule A stub's printed TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED (p3) = Summary Page line 4. Summary Page LINE 1 Column A prints a DIFFERENT figure, $25,215.00, and the gap is exactly $387.15 - which is exactly one transcribed row, 3/8/2018 Nathan Evershed, Attorney/SLCo DA, $387.15 (contributions line 77). So line 1 was written before that row was added and lines 4/5/7 were written after. Reconciled against the anchor whose SCOPE matches the schedule, per the reconciliation-basis rule; both printed figures are retained verbatim and neither was recomputed.

expenditures.detail: 83 transcribed rows sum to 7,164.47 EXACTLY = the attachment's printed grand total (p9 'Total') = the county Schedule B stub's printed TOTAL EXPENDITUTRES MADE (p7) = Summary Page line 6. Summary Page LINE 2 Column A prints $6,838.22, $326.25 lower. Unlike the contributions gap, this $326.25 does NOT equal any single transcribed row and no subset was identified on the page, so the cause is named only as far as the document supports it: line 2 is a stale figure that lines 6/7 supersede. Nothing was adjusted; both figures kept verbatim.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: p3 (county Schedule A stub) and p7 (county Schedule B stub) both print SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE and both were LEFT BLANK by the filer; the attachment pages print no per-page subtotal either. The only page/side gate that exists is the attachment's own printed grand total on its last page (p6 'Total $25,602.15', p9 'Total $7,164.47'), which is also what the county stubs' TOTAL cells repeat. Rows gate on it EXACTLY on both sides.
itemized.escalation_note: pp.8-9 were each re-read as six and five overlapping vertical record-strips upsampled 2x over the 200 dpi rotated render, on top of the full-page read, and the two independent readings agreed row-for-row (45 and 38 rows, same amounts). One diagnostic strip was used to settle the attachment's rotation/record axis before any value was accepted. No cell needed a 600-1200 dpi crop: the attachment is typed, not handwritten, and every figure was legible at the base render.
